lyrics.originalText:
जय शिव ओंकारा, हर जय शिव ओंकारा।
ब्रह्मा विष्णु सदाशिव अर्द्धांगी धारा॥
lyrics.transliteration:
Jai Shiv Omkara, Har Jai Shiv Omkara
Brahma Vishnu Sadashiv Ardhangi Dhara
lyrics.translation: Glory to You, Lord Shiva, who wears the sacred Om symbol, and whose form is shared with Goddess Parvati.

lyrics.originalText:
एकानन चतुरानन पञ्चानन राजे।
हंसासन गरुड़ासन वृषवाहन साजे॥
lyrics.transliteration:
Ekanan Chaturanan Panchanan Raje
Hansasan Garudasan Vrishvahan Saje
lyrics.translation: Having one, four, or five faces, riding on the swan, the eagle, and the bull (Nandi) elegantly.

lyrics.originalText:
जय गणेश जय गणेश जय गणेश देवा।
माता जाकी पार्वती पिता महादेवा॥
lyrics.transliteration:
Jai Ganesh Jai Ganesh Jai Ganesh Deva
Mata Jaki Parvati Pita Mahadeva
lyrics.translation: Glory to Ganesha! Mother is Parvati, Father is Lord Shiva.

lyrics.originalText:
एकदन्त दयावन्त चार भुजाधारी।
माथे पर तिलक सोहे मूसे की सवारी॥
lyrics.transliteration:
Ekadant Dayavant Char Bhujadhari
Mathe Par Tilak Sohe Moose Ki Sawari
lyrics.translation: Single-tusked, merciful, holding weapons in four arms, wearing a red forehead mark, and riding a mouse.

lyrics.originalText:
जय अम्बे गौरी, मैया जय श्यामा गौरी।
तुमको निसिदिन ध्यावत, हरि ब्रह्मा सिवरी॥
lyrics.transliteration:
Jai Ambe Gauri, Maiya Jai Shyama Gauri
Tumko Nisidin Dhyavat, Hari Brahma Sivri
lyrics.translation: Glory to You, Mother Gauri, who is worshipped day and night by Vishnu, Brahma, and Shiva.
